description.value: The caster can emulate the Anima’s ability to release a crimson rainbow of lights, hitting all foes within a 20-ft.-cone radius. All creatures in the area of effect are inflicted with the Deprotect (II) and Deshell (II) status effects for 1d6 rounds unless they must make a Will save to negate the status effects. Learned From Anima and Green Dragon Family
